title: WendComboBox
description: A labeled, multi-select dropdown with optional help text. Selected options render as removable wend-chip pills inside the field; renders a Floating UI-positioned option panel where each wend-option shows a checkbox indicator. Consumers slot in wend-option children.

x-wend-slots.name: (default)
x-wend-slots.description: wend-option elements this combo box can choose between.

label.description: The combo box's label text. Can be an empty string for a label-less field.

values.description: Values (string[]) of the currently selected wend-option children. A complex (array) prop — set via the JS property (el.values = [...]), not an HTML attribute.

placeholder.description: Text shown in the field when no option is selected.

help-text.description: Supplementary message shown below the field, e.g. a validation message. Can be an empty string to render nothing.

show-help-text.description: Whether the help text is rendered.

state.description: Validation state of the field. Drives the field's border color and the help text's tone.

disabled.description: Disables the combo box and every wend-option child.

required.description: Marks the field as required. Renders a marker after the label and sets aria-required on the field.

name.description: Name submitted for this combo box when part of a form.
